newsitem.title: USA: Hillenbrand files counterclaim to Kinetic.
newsitem.headline: Hillenbrand files counterclaim to Kinetic.

text.p: Hillenbrand Industries Inc said Monday it filed a counterclaim to an antitrust lawsuit filed in 1995 by Kinetic Concepts Inc against Hillenbrand and its wholly owned Hill-Rom Co Inc.

Both Hill-Rom and Kinetic Concepts manufacture, sell and rent therapeutic specialty beds, which are designed for use in acute and long-term care facilities for treating burns, pressure sores and other illnesses.

Hillenbrand's counterclaim, filed November 20 in U.S. District Court in San Antonio, Texas, charges that Kinetic Concepts has attempted to monopolize the therapeutic bed market and to interfere with Hillenbrand/Hill-Rom's business relationships by conducting a campaign of anticompetitive conduct.
